  /* Search no-results / null-search gate (Product trigger only): the section stays
     hidden until <fredhopper-search> flags either state on <html> — FHR drives
     results client-side, so the native search count can't gate this server-side.
     `data-fhr-search-empty` = a submitted term settled with zero results;
     `data-fhr-search-idle` = a bare /search visit with no term at all — both get
     this cross-sell carousel instead of an empty page. */
  [data-fhr-recommendations-section][data-fhr-on-search],

    --core-carousel-gap: var(--spacing-productcard-gridgap);
    /* Mobile: one card + 1/5 of the next visible. The track is the viewport minus
       the left page-margin gutter and one gap; dividing it by
       (items_to_show_mobile + 0.2) sizes each card so the next peeks by a fifth.
       Jo Malone overrides the width with its shared mobile card token. */
    --core-carousel-slide-width: var(--spacing-carousel-mobile-card-width, calc((100vw - var(--spacing-pagemargin) - var(--core-carousel-gap)) / 1.2));
    /* Single card on mobile → no inter-card gap offset. */
    --core-carousel-slide-gap-per-slide: 0px;
  }
  /* Align the cards by the header's config when they don't fill the track; `safe`
     falls back to flex-start on overflow so scroll + the mobile peek still work. */

    justify-content: safe center;

                  if (recommendationPercentage) recommendationPercentage.style.display = 'none'
                  if (filters) filters.style.display = 'none'
                  if (search) search.style.display = 'none'
                }

                // Swap PowerReviews' own search glyph for the brand sprite icon; guard by content because
                // PR re-renders inside the wrapper. `data-brand-icon` scopes the `.pr-search-icon svg path`
                // fill overrides away from this stroke-based icon (see src/styles/_base.css).
                const brandSearchIconSrc = "\/\/www.clinique.com\/cdn\/shop\/t\/158\/assets\/icons.svg?v=47777223644564734031793726698"
                function swapSearchIcon() {
                  container.querySelectorAll('.pr-search-icon').forEach(iconWrap => {
                    if (iconWrap.querySelector('use')) return
                    iconWrap.innerHTML = `<svg class='block icon-md size-[1em]' aria-hidden='true' focusable='false'><use href='${brandSearchIconSrc}#icon-search'></use></svg>`
                    iconWrap.setAttribute('data-brand-icon', 'true')
                  })
                }
                swapSearchIcon()

                // iOS Safari's picker ignores display:none on <option>; remove the language sort unless it's the active one.
                function removeLanguageSort() {
                  container.querySelectorAll(".pr-rd-sort option[value='language']").forEach(option => {
                    if (!option.selected) option.remove()
                  })
                }
                removeLanguageSort()

                function relocateSnapshotDisclaimer() {
                  container.querySelectorAll('.pr-snippet .pr-rd-incentivized-disclaimer').forEach(disclaimer => {
                    const reviewCount = disclaimer.closest('.pr-snippet')?.querySelector('.pr-snippet-review-count')
                    if (!reviewCount || reviewCount.nextElementSibling === disclaimer) return
                    reviewCount.after(disclaimer)
                  })
                }
                relocateSnapshotDisclaimer()

                // Move incentivized review disclaimer text outside of the accordion. This needs to be done every time the reviews list is re-rendered.
                const disclaimerLabel = "incentivized"
                function relocateIncentivizedDisclaimers() {
                  let reviewDetailItems = container.querySelectorAll('.pr-rd-subratings .pr-rd-def-list')
                  reviewDetailItems.forEach(item => {
                    const reviewFooter = item.closest('.pr-review')?.querySelector('.pr-rd-footer')
                    const textContent = item.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()
                    if (reviewFooter && textContent.includes(disclaimerLabel)) {
                      reviewFooter.prepend(item)
                    }
                  })
                }

                // PowerReviews pins an open filter list to its button's left edge at max-content width, so a
                // filter that wraps to the right of the row pushes it past the viewport and the page scrolls
                // sideways. Shift it left just enough to stay inside the filter row, still under its button.
                function fitFilterOptions() {
                  container.querySelectorAll('.pr-multiselect-options').forEach(list => {
                    const row = list.closest('.pr-rd-review-header-contents')
                    if (!row) return
                    list.style.left = ''
                    list.style.maxWidth = ''
                    if (list.offsetParent === null) return
                    const rowRect = row.getBoundingClientRect()
                    const listRect = list.getBoundingClientRect()
                    list.style.maxWidth = `${rowRect.width}px`
                    const overflow = Math.min(listRect.right, listRect.left + rowRect.width) - rowRect.right
                    if (overflow > 0) list.style.left = `${-overflow}px`
                    list.toggleAttribute('data-classic-scrollbar', list.offsetWidth - list.clientWidth - list.clientLeft * 2 > 0)
                  })
                }
                if (!container.hasAttribute('data-filter-fit-bound')) {
                  container.setAttribute('data-filter-fit-bound', 'true')
                  const scheduleFit = () => requestAnimationFrame(fitFilterOptions)
                  container.addEventListener('click', scheduleFit)
                  container.addEventListener('keydown', scheduleFit)
                }

                const target = document.getElementById("pr-review-display");
                if (target) {
                  const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                    swapSearchIcon();
                    removeLanguageSort();
                    relocateSnapshotDisclaimer();

                    const reviewAdded = mutations.some(mutation =>
                      Array.from(mutation.addedNodes).some(node =>
                        node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE &&
                        node.classList.contains("pr-review")
                      )
                    );

                    if (!reviewAdded) return;

                    relocateIncentivizedDisclaimers();
                  });

                  observer.observe(target, {
                    childList: true,
                    subtree: true
                  });
                }

                relocateIncentivizedDisclaimers();
              } catch (e) {}
            },
            components: {
              ReviewDisplay: 'pr-reviewdisplay'
            }
          };

          if (window.pwrRender) {
            window.pwrRender(config);
            _prInitDone = true;
          }
        }

        initPRReviews();

        if (Shopify.designMode) {
          document.addEventListener('shopify:section:load', function () {
            _prInitDone = false;
            hasAlignedReviewAnchorAfterRender = false;
            initPRReviews();
          });
        }
      })();
    });
  </script>



</div><section id="shopify-section-template--27402600022211__faq_rqdrLa" class="shopify-section section">

</section>
        </main>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href="#privacy-choices"]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        window.OneTrust?.ToggleInfoDisplay()
      })
    })
  })
</script>

<script>
  window.pwr =
    window.pwr ||
    function () {
      ;(pwr.q = pwr.q || []).push(arguments)
    }

  window.pwrRender = function (config) {
    var attempts = 0
    var maxAttempts = 100
    var interval = setInterval(function () {
      attempts++
      if (typeof pwr === 'function' && !pwr.q) {
        clearInterval(interval)
        pwr('render', config)
      } else if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
        clearInterval(interval)
      }
    }, 100)
  }
</script>

  // Define tealiumSettings window variable
  window.tealiumSettings = {};

  // get Value of cookie
  function getCookieVal(name) {
    const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
    const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
    if (parts.length === 2) {
      return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
    }
    return null;
  }

  // set cookie in user's browser if not exist
  function setCookieVal(name, value, days) {
    if (getCookieVal(name) === '' || getCookieVal(name) === null || getCookieVal(name) === undefined) {
      let expires = '';
      if (days) {
        const date = new Date();
        date.setTime(date.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString();
      }
      document.cookie = name + '=' + (value || '') + expires + '; path=/';
    }
  }

  // force set cookie - always updates
  function forceSetCookie(name, value, days) {
    let expires = '';
    if (days) {
      const date = new Date();
      date.setTime(date.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString();
    }
    document.cookie = name + '=' + (value || '') + expires + '; path=/';
  }

  //remove cookie from user's browser if exist
  function removeCookie(name) {
    if (getCookieVal(name) !== '' || getCookieVal(name) !== null || getCookieVal(name) !== undefined) {
      document.cookie = name + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
    }
  }

  // Check debug cookie once per page load and make it globally available
  window.isDebugEnabled = getCookieVal('tealium_debug');

  // Helper function for conditional logging
  function debugLog(...args) {
    if (window.isDebugEnabled) {
      console.log('[Tealium Theme]', ...args);
    }
  }

  // Make debugLog available globally for other snippets
  window.debugLog = debugLog;

  // Handle debug mode and environment override
  // Debug is enabled if: (1) toggle is on, OR (2) environment override is provided
  const debugToggle = '0' === '1';
  const envOverride = '';
  const debugEnabled = debugToggle || envOverride !== '';

  if (debugEnabled) {
    // Set tealium_debug cookie (with environment override if provided, otherwise just 'true')
    forceSetCookie('tealium_debug', envOverride !== '' ? envOverride : 'true', 1);
    forceSetCookie('utagdb', true, 1);

    // Set environment override if provided
    if (envOverride !== '') {
      window.tealiumSettings.environment_ovd = envOverride;
    }
  } else {
    // if tealium_debug is disabled, then remove cookie from user's browser if exist
    removeCookie('tealium_debug');
    removeCookie('utagdb');
  }

  // Handle markets debug window

  if (marketsDebugToggle) {
    // Set markets_debug cookie
    forceSetCookie('markets_debug', 'true', 1);
  } else {

  (function () {
    'use strict';

    // Tealium configuration using IIFE
    window.tealium = (function () {
      var tealium = {
        cookies: {},
        token: '',
        localdomain: window.location.hostname.replace('www.', ''),
        config: {
          account: window.tealiumSettings.account,
          clientProfile: window.tealiumSettings.clientSideProfile,
          serverProfile: window.tealiumSettings.serverSideProfile,
          environment: window.tealiumSettings.environment,
          storefrontToken: window.tealiumSettings.storefrontToken,
          dataSourceId: window.tealiumSettings.serverSideDataSourceId,
          ssFirstPartyDomain: window.tealiumSettings.ssFirstPartyDomain || 'https://collect.tealiumiq.com',
          domain: document.location.host,
          splitCookie: window.tealiumSettings.splitCookie || false,
          splitCookieAllowlist: window.tealiumSettings.splitCookieAllowlist || [],
        },
        currentPath: document.location.pathname,
      };

      window.debugLog('Tealium Core initialized for:', tealium.config.account);

      // Initialize tracking ID
      if (typeof tealium.hitid == 'undefined') {
        tealium.hitid = new Date().valueOf().toString() + Math.random().toString() + 0;
      }

      if (typeof document.referrer !== 'undefined') {
        tealium.referrer = document.referrer;
      }

      // Performance data
      tealium.navdata = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation');
      if (tealium.navdata.length > 0) {
        tealium.navigationEntries = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0];
        tealium.ttfb = tealium.navigationEntries.responseStart - tealium.navigationEntries.requestStart;
      } else {
        tealium.ttfb = 'brokenSafariTTFB';
      }

      // Function to get query string parameter
      tealium.getQueryParam = function (param) {
        var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        return urlParams.get(param) || '';
      };

      // Cookie functions
      tealium.getCookie = function (c_name) {
        // If it's an array, get all cookies and return object
        if (Array.isArray(c_name)) {
          var result = {};
          for (var i = 0; i < c_name.length; i++) {
            var cookieName = c_name[i];
            if (document.cookie.length > 0) {
              var c_start = document.cookie.indexOf(cookieName + '=');
              if (c_start != -1) {
                c_start = c_start + cookieName.length + 1;
                var c_end = document.cookie.indexOf(';', c_start);
                if (c_end == -1) {
                  c_end = document.cookie.length;
                }
                result[cookieName] = unescape(document.cookie.substring(c_start, c_end));
              } else {
                result[cookieName] = '';
              }
            } else {
              result[cookieName] = '';
            }
          }
          return result;
        }

        // Original single cookie logic
        if (document.cookie.length > 0) {
          var c_start = document.cookie.indexOf(c_name + '=');
          if (c_start != -1) {
            c_start = c_start + c_name.length + 1;
            var c_end = document.cookie.indexOf(';', c_start);
            if (c_end == -1) {
              c_end = document.cookie.length;
            }
            return unescape(document.cookie.substring(c_start, c_end));
          }
        }
        return '';
      };

      tealium.setCookie = function (c_name, c_value, days) {
        var expires = '';
        if (days) {
          var date = new Date();
          date.setTime(date.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
          expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString();
        }
        document.cookie = c_name + '=' + c_value + expires + ';Path=/; domain=' + tealium.config.domain + ';';
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Cookie set:', c_name, '=', c_value);
      };

      tealium.writeUtagMain = function (serialized, days, parseFunc, serializeFunc) {
        var COOKIE_NAME = 'utag_main';

        // Check if cookie has delimiters (parseable format)
        var hasDelimiters = serialized.includes('$') && serialized.includes(':');

        if (tealium.config.splitCookie && hasDelimiters) {
          // Split cookie mode: parse and separate by allowlist
          var cookieData = parseFunc(serialized);
          var allowlist = tealium.config.splitCookieAllowlist;
          var allowedData = {};
          var individualCookies = {};

          window.debugLog('Tealium: Splitting cookies, allowlist:', allowlist);

          Object.keys(cookieData).forEach(function (key) {
            if (cookieData[key] !== undefined && cookieData[key] !== '') {
              if (allowlist.includes(key)) {
                allowedData[key] = cookieData[key];
              } else {
                individualCookies[key] = cookieData[key];
              }
            }
          });

          // Write utag_main with only allowlisted values
          var allowedSerialized = serializeFunc(allowedData);
          tealium.setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, allowedSerialized, days);
          window.debugLog('Tealium: utag_main written with allowlisted values:', allowedData);

          // Write individual cookies for non-allowlisted values
          Object.keys(individualCookies).forEach(function (key) {
            var cookieName = 'utag_main_' + key;
            tealium.setCookie(cookieName, individualCookies[key], days);
          });
          window.debugLog('Tealium: Individual cookies written:', Object.keys(individualCookies));

        } else {
          // Standard mode or unparseable format: write single combined cookie
          if (!hasDelimiters && tealium.config.splitCookie) {
            window.debugLog('Tealium: Cookie has no delimiters, preserving as-is (cannot split)');
          }
          tealium.setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, serialized, days);
        }
      };

      tealium.delCookie = function (c_name) {
        document.cookie =
          c_name +
          '=' +
          null +
          ';Path=/; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT; domain=' +
          tealium.config.domain +
          ';';
      };

      tealium.manageUtagMain = function () {
        // --- Helpers ---
        function parseUtagMain(cookie) {
          const parts = {};
          cookie.split('$').forEach((p) => {
            if (!p) return;
            const [key, value] = p.split(':');
            parts[key] = value;
          });
          return parts;
        }

        function serializeUtagMain(obj) {
          return Object.entries(obj)
            .map(([k, v]) => `${k}:${v}`)
            .filter(([k, v]) => v !== '' && v != null)
            .join('$');
        }

        // --- Port of utag.js utag.ut.vi / utag.ut.pad (ut4.54) ---
        // Must stay byte-for-byte compatible with utag.js so v_ids we mint look
        // exactly like the ones utag.js mints (hex, no dashes).
        function pad(a, b) {
          a = '' + (a - 0).toString(16);
          let d = '';
          for (let c = 0; c < b - a.length; c++) d += '0';
          return d + a;
        }

        function tealiumVid() {
          let a = pad(Date.now(), 12);
          const b = '' + Math.random();
          a += pad(b.substring(2, b.length), 16);

          try {
            a += pad(navigator.plugins.length ? navigator.plugins.length : 0, 2);
            a += pad(navigator.userAgent.length, 3);
            a += pad(document.URL.length, 4);
            a += pad(navigator.appVersion.length, 3);
            a += pad(screen.width + screen.height + parseInt(screen.colorDepth ? screen.colorDepth : screen.pixelDepth), 5);
          } catch (e) {
            if (window.utag && typeof window.utag.DB === 'function') window.utag.DB(e);
            a += '12345';
          }

          return a;
        }

        // --- Constants ---
        const SESSION_DURATION = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes
        const COOKIE_LIFETIME_DAYS = 395;
        const COOKIE_NAME = 'utag_main';

        let utagMain = window.tealium.getCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
        let now = Date.now();
        let data;

        // Existing v_id, if any: split_cookie (utag.js 4.50+) keeps it in its own
        // utag_main_v_id cookie, otherwise it lives inside utag_main.
        const vidMatch = utagMain ? utagMain.match(/v_id:([^$]+)/) : null;
        const existingVid = window.tealium.getCookie('utag_main_v_id') || (vidMatch ? vidMatch[1] : '');

        // --- Determine cookie type ---
        const isNewFormat = utagMain && utagMain.includes('v_id:') && utagMain.includes('$_sn:');

        if (!utagMain) {
          // No cookie → create new format, minting v_id the same way utag.js does
          data = {
            v_id: existingVid || tealiumVid(),
            _sn: 1,
            _se: 1,
            _ss: 1,
            _st: now + SESSION_DURATION,
            ses_id: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9),
            _pn: 1,
          };
          window.debugLog('Tealium: Created new utag_main cookie:', data.v_id);
        } else if (!isNewFormat) {
          // Legacy cookie → preserve as-is (never rewritten), report its existing v_id
          data = {
            v_id: existingVid,
            raw_cookie: utagMain,
          };
          window.debugLog('Tealium: Detected legacy utag_main cookie, using existing v_id:', existingVid);
        } else {
          // Existing new-format cookie
          data = parseUtagMain(utagMain);
          const expired = !data._st || now > parseInt(data._st, 10);

          if (expired) {
            // Start new session
            data._sn = (parseInt(data._sn, 10) || 0) + 1;
            data._se = 1;
            data._ss = 1;
            data._st = now + SESSION_DURATION;
            data.ses_id = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9);
            data._pn = (parseInt(data._pn, 10) || 0) + 1;

            window.debugLog('Tealium: Started new session:', data.ses_id);
          } else {
            // Continue current session
            data._ss = '';
            data._se = (parseInt(data._se, 10) || 0) + 1;
            data._pn = (parseInt(data._pn, 10) || 0) + 1;
            data._st = now + SESSION_DURATION;

            window.debugLog('Tealium: Continued session:', data.ses_id);
          }
        }

        // --- Write cookie ---
        const serialized = isNewFormat || !utagMain ? serializeUtagMain(data) : utagMain;
        window.tealium.writeUtagMain(serialized, COOKIE_LIFETIME_DAYS, parseUtagMain, serializeUtagMain);

        return data;
      };

      // Get OS detection
      tealium.getOS = function () {
        var platform = navigator.platform;
        if (platform.includes('Mac')) return 'mac';
        if (platform === 'iPhone') return 'iphone';
        if (platform === 'iPad') return 'ipad';
        if (platform === 'iPod') return 'ipod';
        if (platform.includes('Win')) return 'windows';
        if (platform.includes('Linux')) return 'linux';
        return 'other';
      };

      // Send tracking data to Tealium collect endpoint
      tealium.sendToCollect = function (eventType, eventData) {
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Sending to collect endpoint:', eventType);

        var utagMain = tealium.getCookie('utag_main');

        if (!utagMain) {
          console.error('Tealium: Missing utag_main cookie');
          return;
        }

        // Visitor id, the same lookup manageUtagMain uses above: split_cookie
        // (utag.js 4.50+) keeps v_id in its own utag_main_v_id cookie, otherwise it is
        // inside utag_main as v_id:xxx$. Reading utag_main alone sent an empty visitor
        // id on every browser event whenever split cookie was on.
        var vIdMatch = utagMain.match(/v_id:([^$]+)/);
        var visitorId = tealium.getCookie('utag_main_v_id') || (vIdMatch ? vIdMatch[1] : '');

        var cookieNames = ['_fbc', '_fbp', '_ga', '_shopify_y', '_shopify_s', '__kla_id', '_ttp'];
        var cookies = tealium.getCookie(cookieNames);

        // Get cart token from Shopify's cart cookie
        var cartToken = tealium.getCookie('cart') || '';
        if (!cartToken) {
          window.debugLog('Tealium: No cart token yet (expected on first page view)');
        }

        var collectData = {
          // Event type
          tealium_event: eventType,
          'cp.utag_main': utagMain,
          tealium_visitor_id: visitorId,

          // Cart token for correlation - CRITICAL
          cart_token: cartToken,

          // Event-specific data
          page_url: window.location.href,
          page_title: document.title,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          ttfb: tealium.ttfb,
          os: tealium.getOS(),
          referrer: tealium.referrer || '',

          // Shop data
          shop_domain: 'www.clinique.com',
          page_type: 'product',
        };

        // Add cookies to collect data
        Object.keys(cookies).forEach(function (key) {
          if (cookies[key]) {
            collectData['cp.' + key] = cookies[key];
          }
        });

        // Merge event data directly into collectData (flattened, not stringified)
        if (eventData && typeof eventData === 'object') {
          Object.keys(eventData).forEach(function (key) {
            collectData[key] = eventData[key];
          });
        }

        window.debugLog('Tealium: Collect data:', collectData);

        // Add Tealium configuration to payload (same as Lambda)
        var configBody = {
          tealium_account: tealium.config.account,
          tealium_profile: tealium.config.serverProfile,
          tealium_environment: tealium.config.environment
        };

        // Add data source ID if available (for server-side tracking)
        if (tealium.config.dataSourceId) {
          configBody.tealium_datasource = tealium.config.dataSourceId;
        }

        // Merge collect data with config (same as Lambda spread pattern)
        var payload = JSON.stringify({ ...collectData, ...configBody });

        window.debugLog('Tealium: POST payload:', payload);

        // Send via POST to /event endpoint (use first-party domain if configured)
        // Ensure ssFirstPartyDomain has trailing slash
        var domain = tealium.config.ssFirstPartyDomain;
        if (domain && !domain.endsWith('/')) {
          domain += '/';
        }
        const collectUrl = domain + 'event';
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Collect URL:', collectUrl);

        fetch(collectUrl, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          },
          body: payload
        })
          .then(function (response) {
            if (response.ok) {
              window.debugLog('Tealium: Data sent to collect endpoint successfully');
            } else {
              console.error('Tealium: Failed to send data, status:', response.status);
            }
          })
          .catch(function (error) {
            console.error('Tealium: Failed to send data to collect endpoint:', error);
          });
      };

      // Function to get cart token via API
      tealium.getCartToken = function () {
        return fetch('/cart.js')
          .then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
          })
          .then(function (cart) {
            var fullToken = cart.token || null;
            return fullToken ? fullToken.split('?')[0] : null;
          })
          .catch(function (error) {
            console.warn('Tealium: Failed to get cart token:', error);
            return null;
          });
      };

      // Return the tealium object
      return tealium;
    })();

    // Initialize utag_main cookie
    window.tealium.manageUtagMain();
  })();

      if (window.tealiumCustomerData) {
        landingData = Object.assign({}, landingData, window.tealiumCustomerData);
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Customer data added to landing event');
      }

      // Merge collection data if on collection page
      if (window.tealiumCollectionData) {
        landingData = Object.assign({}, landingData, window.tealiumCollectionData);
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Collection data added to landing event');
      }

      // Merge collection products array data
      if (window.tealiumCollectionProducts) {
        landingData = Object.assign({}, landingData, window.tealiumCollectionProducts);
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Collection products added to landing event');
      }

      window.tealium.sendToCollect('landing', landingData);
    });

    // Cart attributes state
    var lastCartToken = null;
    var isProcessing = false;
    var debounceTimer = null;
    var attributesAdded = false;

    // Simple cookie getter
    window.tealium.getCookieSimple = function (name) {
      const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
      const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
      if (parts.length === 2) return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
      return null;
    };

    // Capture and persist tracking params on every page load
    window.tealium.captureTrackingParams = function() {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

      const trackingParams = [
        'fbclid', 'gclid', 'gbraid', 'wbraid', 'msclkid',
        'ttclid', 'twclid', 'li_fat_id', 'ScCid', '_kx'
      ];
      const utmParams = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
      const allParams = trackingParams.concat(utmParams);

      allParams.forEach(function(param) {
        const value = urlParams.get(param);
        if (value) {
          sessionStorage.setItem('tealium_' + param, value);
          window.debugLog('Tealium: Captured param:', param, '=', value);
        }
      });
    };

    window.tealium.getTealiumTrackingAttributes = function (cartToken) {
      const attributes = [];

      // Get Tealium visitor data from utag_main cookie
      const utagMain = window.tealium.getCookieSimple('utag_main');
      if (utagMain) attributes.push({ key: 'tealium_utag_main', value: utagMain });

      // The Tealium visitor id, read straight from the data layer utag.js builds.
      // This is what server-side events stitch on, and it is not always in
      // utag_main, so it goes on the cart as its own attribute.
      const visitorId =
        window.utag && window.utag.data ? window.utag.data['cp.utag_main_v_id'] : null;
      if (visitorId) {
        attributes.push({ key: 'tealium_visitor_id', value: visitorId });
      } else {
        window.debugLog('Tealium: No visitor id on utag.data, cart attribute omitted');
      }

      // Add cart token - CRITICAL for correlation
      if (cartToken) {
        attributes.push({ key: 'tealium_cart_token', value: cartToken });
      }

      // Retrieve persisted tracking params from sessionStorage
      const trackingParams = [
        'fbclid', 'gclid', 'gbraid', 'wbraid', 'msclkid',
        'ttclid', 'twclid', 'li_fat_id', 'ScCid', '_kx'
      ];
      const utmParams = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
      const allParams = trackingParams.concat(utmParams);

      allParams.forEach(function(param) {
        const value = sessionStorage.getItem('tealium_' + param);
        if (value) {
          attributes.push({ key: 'tealium_' + param, value: value });
        }
      });

      window.debugLog('Tealium: Attributes to add to cart:', attributes);
      return attributes;
    };

    window.tealium.updateCartAttributesWithTracking = function (cartToken, trackingAttributes) {
      const getCartQuery = `
        query getCart($cartId: ID!) {
            cart(id: $cartId) {
                attributes {
                    key
                    value
                }
            }
        }
    `;

      const updateMutation = `
        mutation cartAttributesUpdate($cartId: ID!, $attributes: [AttributeInput!]!) {
            cartAttributesUpdate(cartId: $cartId, attributes: $attributes) {
                cart {
                    id
                    attributes {
                        key
                        value
                    }
                }
                userErrors {
                    field
                    message
                }
            }
        }
    `;

      try {
        const cartId = `gid://shopify/Cart/${cartToken}`;
        const storefrontToken = window.tealium.config.storefrontToken;

        if (!storefrontToken) {
          console.error('Tealium: No storefront token available');
          return;
        }

        fetch(`https://${window.Shopify.shop}/api/2025-01/graphql.json`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-Shopify-Storefront-Access-Token': storefrontToken,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            query: getCartQuery,
            variables: { cartId },
          }),
        })
          .then(function (cartResponse) {
            return cartResponse.json();
          })
          .then(function (cartResult) {
            window.debugLog('Tealium: Cart query result:', cartResult);

            const cart = cartResult.data?.cart;

            if (!cart) {
              console.error('Tealium: Cart not found');
              return;
            }

            const existingAttributes = cart.attributes || [];

            // Check if our tracking attributes already exist
            const hasTealiumAttributes = existingAttributes.some((attr) => attr.key.startsWith('tealium_'));
            if (hasTealiumAttributes) {
              window.debugLog('Tealium: Tracking attributes already exist');
              return;
            }

            // Merge existing with new tracking attributes
            const allAttributes = [...existingAttributes, ...trackingAttributes];

            window.debugLog('Tealium: Merging attributes:', {
              existing: existingAttributes,
              new: trackingAttributes,
              merged: allAttributes,
            });

            // Update with all attributes
            return fetch(`https://${window.Shopify.shop}/api/2025-01/graphql.json`, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-Shopify-Storefront-Access-Token': storefrontToken,
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                query: updateMutation,
                variables: {
                  cartId,
                  attributes: allAttributes,
                },
              }),
            })
              .then(function (updateResponse) {
                return updateResponse.json();
              })
              .then(function (updateResult) {
                window.debugLog('Tealium: Cart attributes update result:', updateResult);

                if (updateResult.errors) {
                  console.error('Tealium: Cart attributes update failed:', updateResult.errors);
                } else if (updateResult.data?.cartAttributesUpdate?.userErrors?.length > 0) {
                  console.error(
                    'Tealium: Cart attributes update user errors:',
                    updateResult.data.cartAttributesUpdate.userErrors
                  );
                } else {
                  window.debugLog('Tealium: Cart attributes updated successfully');
                  sessionStorage.setItem('tealiumCartAttributesVerified_' + cartToken, 'true');
                }
              })
              .catch(function (error) {
                console.error('Tealium: Failed to update cart attributes:', error);
              });
          })
          .catch(function (error) {
            console.error('Tealium: Failed to fetch cart:', error);
          });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Tealium: Failed to update cart attributes:', error);
      }
    };

    // Intercept fetch for cart requests
    var originalFetch = window.fetch;
    window.fetch = function() {
      var args = arguments;
      var url = args[0];

      var isCartRequest = typeof url === 'string' &&
        (url.includes('/cart/add') || url.includes('/cart/change') || url.includes('/cart/update'));

      return originalFetch.apply(this, args).then(function(response) {
        if (isCartRequest && response.ok && !attributesAdded) {
          window.debugLog('Tealium: Cart request detected via fetch');
          setTimeout(function() {
            window.tealium.addAttributesOnce();
          }, 200);
        }
        return response;
      });
    };

    // Intercept XHR for cart requests
    var originalOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
    var originalSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function(method, url, async, user, pass) {
      this._interceptedUrl = url;
      return originalOpen.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function(body) {
      var url = this._interceptedUrl;
      var isCartRequest = url &&
        (url.includes('/cart/add') || url.includes('/cart/change') || url.includes('/cart/update'));

      if (isCartRequest && !attributesAdded) {
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Cart request detected via XHR');
        this.addEventListener('load', function() {
          if (this.status >= 200 && this.status < 300) {
            setTimeout(function() {
              window.tealium.addAttributesOnce();
            }, 200);
          }
        });
      }
      return originalSend.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    // Add attributes only once
    window.tealium.addAttributesOnce = function() {
      if (attributesAdded) {
        window.debugLog('Tealium: Attributes already added, skipping');
        return;
      }

      fetch('/cart.js')
        .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
        .then(function(cart) {
          if (cart.token && cart.item_count > 0) {
            window.debugLog('Tealium: Cart found:', cart.token);
            attributesAdded = true;

            if (window.tealium.config.storefrontToken) {
              var trackingAttributes = window.tealium.getTealiumTrackingAttributes(cart.token);
              if (trackingAttributes.length > 0) {
                window.tealium.updateCartAttributesWithTracking(cart.token, trackingAttributes);
              }
            } else {
              window.debugLog('Tealium: Storefront API disabled, skipping cart attributes');
            }
          }
        })
        .catch(function(error) {
          console.error('Tealium: Failed in addAttributesOnce:', error);
        });
    };

    window.tealium.observeCartChanges = function () {
      var cartObserver = new PerformanceObserver(function (list) {
        list.getEntries().forEach(function (entry) {
          var isValidRequestType = ['xmlhttprequest', 'fetch'].includes(entry.initiatorType);
          var isCartJsRequest = entry.name.includes('/cart.js');

          if (isValidRequestType && isCartJsRequest && !isProcessing) {
            clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
            debounceTimer = setTimeout(window.tealium.checkForCartChanges, 500);
          }
        });
      });
      cartObserver.observe({ entryTypes: ['resource'] });
    };

    window.tealium.checkForCartChanges = function () {
      if (isProcessing) return;

      try {
        isProcessing = true;

        fetch('/cart.js')
          .then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
          })
          .then(function (cart) {
            if (
              cart.item_count > 0 &&
              cart.token !== lastCartToken &&
              !sessionStorage.getItem('cart_' + cart.token)
            ) {
              window.debugLog('Tealium: New cart detected:', cart.token);
              lastCartToken = cart.token;
              window.tealium.handleCartChange(cart);
            }
          })
          .catch(function (error) {
            console.error('Tealium: Failed to check cart changes:', error);
          })
          .finally(function () {
            setTimeout(function () {
              isProcessing = false;
            }, 2000);
          });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Tealium: Failed to check cart changes:', error);
        setTimeout(function () {
          isProcessing = false;
        }, 2000);
      }
    };

    window.tealium.handleCartChange = function (cart) {
      try {
        const cartToken = cart.token;
        sessionStorage.setItem('cart_' + cartToken, 'true');

        if (window.tealium.config.storefrontToken) {
          const trackingAttributes = window.tealium.getTealiumTrackingAttributes(cartToken);
          if (trackingAttributes.length > 0) {
            window.debugLog('Tealium: Adding tracking attributes to cart:', cartToken);
            window.tealium.updateCartAttributesWithTracking(cartToken, trackingAttributes);
          }
        } else {
          window.debugLog('Tealium: Storefront API disabled, skipping cart attributes');
        }

        // Send cart change event to collect endpoint
        window.tealium.sendToCollect('cart_cl_updated', {
          cart_token: cartToken
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Tealium: Failed to handle cart change:', error);
      }
    };

    window.tealium.checkExistingCart = function () {
      fetch('/cart.js')
        .then(function (response) {
          return response.json();
        })
        .then(function (cart) {
          if (cart.token && cart.item_count > 0) {
            window.debugLog('Tealium: Existing cart found on page load:', cart.token);
            window.tealium.handleCartChange(cart);
          } else {
            window.debugLog('Tealium: No existing cart found');
          }
        })
        .catch(function (error) {
          console.error('Tealium: Failed to check existing cart:', error);
        });
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      // Capture tracking params from URL on every page load
      window.tealium.captureTrackingParams();

      window.tealium.observeCartChanges();
      // Check for existing cart when page loads
      setTimeout(window.tealium.checkExistingCart, 1000);
    });
  })();
</script>
<!-- END app snippet -->

<script type="text/javascript">
  // Load utag.js using client-side profile
  (function (a, b, c, d) {
    // Ensure firstPartyDomain has trailing slash and handle "null" string
    var domain = window.tealiumSettings.firstPartyDomain;
    var useFirstParty = domain && domain !== 'null' && domain !== '' && domain !== '//tags.tiqcdn.com/utag/';

    if (!useFirstParty) {
      domain = '//tags.tiqcdn.com/utag/';
    }
    if (domain && !domain.endsWith('/')) {
      domain += '/';
    }

    // When using first-party domain, don't append account (it's already in the domain path)
    // Standard CDN: //tags.tiqcdn.com/utag/{account}/{profile}/{env}/utag.js
    // First-party:  https://data.example.com/{profile}/{env}/utag.js
    a = domain +
      (useFirstParty ? '' : window.tealiumSettings.account + '/') +
      window.tealiumSettings.clientSideProfile +  // Use client-side profile
      '/' +
      window.tealiumSettings.environment +
      '/' +
      'utag.js';
    b = document;
    c = 'script';
    d = b.createElement(c);
    d.src = a;
    d.type = 'text/java' + c;
    d.async = true;
    a = b.getElementsByTagName(c)[0];
    a.parentNode.insertBefore(d, a);
  })();
</script>

    // manual cookie check
    function hasCookie(name) {
      return document.cookie.split(';').some(c => c.trim().startsWith(name + '='));
    }
    
    function delete_cookie(name) {
        document.cookie = name + '=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT;';
    };
    
    function setCookie(name, value, days) {
    const expires = new Date();
    expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
    document.cookie = `${name}=${value};expires=${expires.toUTCString()};path=/`;
    }


    // not used, but keeping it around in case we need it for edge case.   
    function poll_it(){    
         var sleep = duration => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, duration));      
         var poll = (promiseFn, duration) => {
             return promiseFn().then(() => {
                 return sleep(duration).then(() => {
                     // If the cookie has been found, resolve with 'stop'
                     if (hasCookie('tealium_que')) {
                         console.log("Triggered Que Process -check_cookie Poll");
                         return 'stop';
                     } else {
                         // If the cookie hasn't been found, continue polling
                         return poll(promiseFn, duration);
                     }
                 });
             });
         };
         
         poll(() => {
             return new Promise(resolve => {
                 window.debugLog('Check Cookie');
                 resolve(); // Resolve the promise to continue polling
             });
         }, 1000).then(result => {
             if (result === 'stop') {
                 window.debugLog('Polling stopped.');
                 process_que();
             }
         });
      
    }
     
    // change event where supported
    window.debugLog("ENTERING COOKIE HANDLERS   ---------------------------------")
    var cookieDesc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Document.prototype, 'cookie') || Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLDocument.prototype, 'cookie'); 
    if (typeof window.cookieStore !== 'undefined'){
      window.cookieStore.addEventListener('change', function(c){ 
         if (c.changed.length > 0){  // don't care about deletes, just in case checking the array and not assuming ours is the only change.
            //console.log(c);
            c.changed.forEach(function(c_list){
               if (c_list.name == 'tealium_que'){
                  // process que
                  window.debugLog("Triggered Que Process - cookiestore");
                  process_que();
               }
            })
         }
      });
    } else if (cookieDesc && cookieDesc.configurable) {
        Object.defineProperty(document, 'cookie', {
            get: function() {
                return cookieDesc.get.call(document);
            },
            set: function(val) {
                //window.debugLog(val);

                    cookieDesc.set.call(document, val);
                }
                else {

      if (que){

           window.debugLog("Que to process ", que)
           que_events_to_tealium(que); // sync call as is all localStorage
           clear_que();
        }
      }
    }

function collection_view(data){
   //window.utag_cfg_ovrd.noview = true
   var eventData = data.event_data.collection;  //productVariants && title
    window.debugLog("Collection data from Que", data)
    
    var tealiumTagData = {
 
     tealium_event: "category_view",
     product_on_page: eventData.productVariants.map(product => product.id)

    }
    tealiumTagData   = {...window.utag_data, ...tealiumTagData}; 
    utag.link(tealiumTagData);
}  

  
function product_view(data){
   //window.utag_cfg_ovrd.noview = true
   var eventData = data.productVariant;  //productVariants && title
    window.debugLog("Product data ", data)
    var tealiumTagData = {
 
     tealium_event: "product_view"

    }
    tealiumTagData   = {...window.utag_data, ...tealiumTagData}; 
    utag.link(tealiumTagData);
}  

function page_view(data){
 
    var tealiumTagData = {
     tealium_event: "page_view"
    }
  
    tealiumTagData   = {...window.utag_data, ...tealiumTagData}; 
    utag.view(tealiumTagData);
}    
 
 
  
function que_events_to_tealium(q_data){

      // Check if utag is ready before processing events
      if (typeof utag === 'undefined') {
          window.debugLog('utag not yet loaded, waiting...');

          // Poll for utag to be ready
          var checkUtag = setInterval(function() {
              if (typeof utag !== 'undefined') {
                  window.debugLog('utag loaded, processing queue');
                  clearInterval(checkUtag);
                  processEvents(q_data);
              }
          }, 100); // Check every 100ms

          // Timeout after 10 seconds
          setTimeout(function() {
              if (typeof utag === 'undefined') {
                  console.error('utag failed to load after 10 seconds, queue not processed');
                  clearInterval(checkUtag);
              }
          }, 10000);

          return;
      }

      // If utag is already loaded, process immediately
      processEvents(q_data);
    }

function processEvents(q_data) {
      //utag.view(event data blah blah)
      q_data.forEach(function(t){
          window.debugLog("Mapping Events utag.view")
          window.debugLog("Parsing Event Data",t.name);
          window.debugLog("Firing utag.views");
          if (t.name && !t.event_name){
            t.event_name = t.name
          }
          if (!t.event_name){
            console.error("DOM EVENT DETECTED",t)
          }

          switch (t.event_name) {
            case 'page_view':
              window.debugLog('SENDING Page View');
              page_view(t);
              break;
            case 'category_view':
              window.debugLog('SENDING Collection View');
              collection_view(t);
              break;
            case 'product_view':
              window.debugLog("SENDING Product View");
              product_view(t);
              break;
            case 'cart_add':
              window.debugLog('SENDING: add to cart');
              get_current_cart(cart_update, t);
            break;
            case 'cart_remove':
              window.debugLog('SENDING: removed cart')
              get_current_cart(cart_update, t);
            break;
            case 'cart_view':
              window.debugLog('SENDING: cart_view');
              cart_view(t);
            break;
            case 'search':
              window.debugLog('SENDING: search');
              search(t);
              break;
            default:
               window.debugLog('------------Unhanded Event-', t.event_name);
          }
      });

    // TODO:  checkout_started,
    }
    
function clear_que(){
        localStorage.setItem('tealium_que',JSON.stringify([])); 
        delete_cookie('tealium_que');
    }

  <script>
    (function() {
      // Build map of country -> available languages
      var countryLanguages = {
        
          'US': ['en']
        
      };

      var countrySelect = document.querySelector('#MarketSwitcherForm select[name="country_code"]');
      var languageSelect = document.getElementById('languageSelector');

      function updateLanguageOptions() {
        var selectedCountry = countrySelect.value;
        var availableLangs = countryLanguages[selectedCountry] || [];
        var currentLangValue = languageSelect.value;
        var firstAvailable = null;

        for (var i = 0; i < languageSelect.options.length; i++) {
          var option = languageSelect.options[i];
          var isAvailable = availableLangs.indexOf(option.value) !== -1;

          option.disabled = !isAvailable;
          option.style.color = isAvailable ? '' : '#999';

          if (isAvailable && !firstAvailable) {
            firstAvailable = option.value;
          }
        }

        // If current selection is not available, switch to first available
        if (availableLangs.indexOf(currentLangValue) === -1 && firstAvailable) {
          languageSelect.value = firstAvailable;
        }
      }

      countrySelect.addEventListener('change', updateLanguageOptions);

      // Run on page load to set initial state
      updateLanguageOptions();
    })();
  </script>
</div>

<script>
  (function() {
    // Check for markets_debug cookie
    const getCookie = function(name) {
      const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
      const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
      if (parts.length === 2) {
        return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
      }
      return null;
    };

    const marketsDebug = getCookie('markets_debug');

    // Only show debug window if cookie is set to 'true'
    if (marketsDebug === 'true') {
      const debugPanel = document.getElementById('tealium-markets-debug');
      if (debugPanel) {
        debugPanel.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }
  })();
</script>
